notes: Parent DSM01 (called wildtype, itself lacking adhE, pta, ldhA, frdA) is the reference; SBA01 is its evolved descendant. Acetate vs glucose is a carbon-source (medium) difference, treatment none. Library kit is TruSeq Stranded mRNA and molecule says polyA RNA, so rrna_removal polyA as stated. Temperature, aeration and strain background not given; perturbed genes of the parent left empty.
